definitions.gloss: end, tail end, last part, conclusion
definitions.explanation: The very end or final portion of a document, list, sequence, or other ordered item. Often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {文|ぶん}の{末尾|まつび}に{句点|くてん}を{打|う}つ。
examples.english: To put a period at the end of a sentence.

examples.japanese: {名簿|めいぼ}の{末尾|まつび}に{名前|なまえ}を{追加|ついか}した。
examples.english: I added a name at the end of the roster.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{末尾|まつび}に{参考|さんこう}{文献|ぶんけん}の{一覧|いちらん}が{載|の}っているので、{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: A list of references is included at the end of the report, so please check it.

notes:
USAGE:
{末尾|まつび} is a somewhat formal or written term. In everyday speech, {最後|さいご} (last, end) is more common. {末尾|まつび} specifically implies the spatial or sequential end of something, rather than the temporal end.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {末尾|まつび}に{追加|ついか}する: to add at the end
- {末尾|まつび}に{記載|きさい}する: to note at the end
- {文|ぶん}の{末尾|まつび}: end of a sentence
- {一覧|いちらん}の{末尾|まつび}: end of the list

SIMILAR WORDS:
{末尾|まつび} (end/tail of a document or sequence) vs. {冒頭|ぼうとう} (beginning/opening of a text). These are commonly paired as opposites in written Japanese.
